items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex stuck in range; Vedanta Power, IDBI Bank lead SmallCap gains
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap fell 0.27 per cent and 0.16 per cent, respectively

items.title: Sebi proposes market cap-based SME listing norms, lower application size
items.description: Sebi proposes halving the minimum SME IPO application value to Rs 1 lakh, raising the operating profit threshold and easing offer-for-sale restrictions for institutional investors

items.title: Jio Platforms announces IPO subscription window from October 21 to 23
items.description: The anchor investor bidding date is October 19, while the public issue will remain open for three days, from October 21 to October 23, 2026
